findings.title: Mercy operates inside the self's evil-directed command
findings.claim: The mercy named in the exception meets the self's evil-directed command as an operative boundary: it interrupts the command's movement and protects the person from its consequence while the diagnosis of the self remains in place.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries command in أَمَّارَةٌۢ, harmful/ugly outcome in السُّوءِ, active mercy in رَحِمَ, and protective forgiveness in غَفُورٌ. The supplied wider command, restraint, mercy-exception, and Ghafur-Rahim connections make contact with those focus forms, changing the closing mercy from a generic consolation into a process that limits and protects within the stated danger.
findings.reader_payoff: The exception becomes an action within the moral mechanism: the self's recurring pull toward evil remains visible, while mercy is seen doing the work that stops its course and shields its result.
findings.containment: This retains the focus's ordinary claim that the self directs toward evil. It does not claim that every impulse becomes an act, that mercy removes accountability, or that every available meaning of the cited roots is active.

epistemic.reason: The retained candidate has a trusted citable support record with exact focus branch anchors; connection rows are used as corroborating contextual triggers, with their target-morphology limitation kept visible in the boundary.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, yasaklamanın karşıtı olan yapma isteği ve yükümlü kılmadır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَمَّارَةٌۢ carries the directive force of an inward demand toward an action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: السُّوءِ supplies the directed harmful object, while the 2:169 and 79:40 connections supply wider command-toward-evil and inward-restraint contrasts.
branch_activations.activation: The command facet is attached to the focus predicate and its harmful complement, then widened by supplied command/restraint relations; the contact makes the inward pressure a recurring directive rather than a single passing urge.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The self's movement toward evil is perceptible as an internally issuing demand with a course that can be restrained.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not thereby become a statement about every command use of the root or about legitimate authority.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bu iç yöneliş, acınan kişiyi esirgemeyi ve ona iyilikte bulunmayı gerektiren etkin bir sonuç taşır.
branch_activations.carrier: رَحِمَ and رَّحِيمٌ carry active sparing, care, and good reaching the person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's evil-directed command and exception particle set mercy against the ordinary course of harm, while 44:42 supplies a wider mercy-as-exception relation.
branch_activations.activation: Mercy is connected to the point at which evil is interrupted, so it functions as an effective response rather than a detached divine attribute.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Mercy is newly legible as the force that opens a protected interval within the self's harmful tendency.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the exception into a promise that the self has no harmful tendency or that mercy is mere sentiment.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, bir şeyin çirkin, kötü veya nitelikçe bozuk oluşuna ilişkin olumsuz değerlendirmedir.
branch_activations.carrier: السُّوءِ carries badness as a category of morally or qualitatively damaged outcome.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The command predicate directs itself toward this category, and 2:169 supplies a wider command-to-evil relation.
branch_activations.activation: The governed object is not an isolated incident but the named class of badness toward which the directive points.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The self's danger is seen as a standing orientation toward harmful or degraded outcomes.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not activate the branch's bodily, hidden-place, or purely formulaic neighboring uses.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: birini üzme veya ona kötülük etme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylem, birine iyi davranmanın tersine kötü davranmak veya ona kötülük etmek biçiminde genişler.
branch_activations.carrier: السُّوءِ carries harm as something that can reach and burden a person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The inward command supplies the agent-like direction, while 2:169 and 18:58 provide wider evil and consequence relations.
branch_activations.activation: The evil object and the directive predicate meet as a mechanism in which harm is ordered from within and then met by protective mercy.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The closing protection is understood as protection from an inwardly directed harm, not only as an abstract pardon.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the focus specifies a particular victim, act, or completed consequence.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: birini üzme veya ona kötülük etme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, bir kişide sevinmenin karşıtı olan üzüntü veya sıkıntı etkisini doğurmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: السُّوءِ carries the distressing effect that can be brought to a person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The command predicate gives the harmful category an inward direction, while 18:58 supplies a wider mercy-and-consequence contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The core effect facet grounds the extension into an actual harm-bearing result rather than an abstract moral label.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The evil named by the focus remains connected to the distress it can cause.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not specify a particular harmed person or claim that a completed harm is narrated.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi örterek onu dış etkiden korumak ya da görünmez kılmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: غَفُورٌ carries covering as a protective function after the harmful tendency has been named.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The evil clause and mercy clause establish the danger and the response, while 18:58 supplies a wider mercy-and-forgiveness delay of reckoning.
branch_activations.activation: The protective-covering facet contacts the named harmful course and its mercy exception, changing covering into shelter from an effect that could otherwise reach the person.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Forgiveness can be perceived as protective covering within the process, after the danger is exposed.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not activate physical coverings, cloth, clouds, or every other homonymous use of the branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bağışlamanın sonucu, suç işleyeni cezanın ona ulaşmasından korumaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: غَفُورٌ carries forgiveness together with protection from the punitive reach of fault.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names evil before the closing attribute, and 27:11 supplies a wider wrongdoing-to-Ghafur-Rahim process parallel.
branch_activations.activation: The forgiveness facet meets the prior evil-directed tendency and the mercy exception, so the result is a protective release from consequence rather than a denial that fault exists.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final divine naming changes the scene from diagnosis alone to a path in which protection from fault's consequence remains possible.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not specify a legal procedure, a completed act of repentance, or the removal of personal responsibility.

findings.title: Self-clearance remains attached to the living self
findings.claim: The opening refusal of self-clearance keeps a particular vindication from becoming total innocence: the clearance act remains attached to the speaker's own living self, so responsibility stays with a person capable of action and inward response.
findings.mechanism: The nominated clearance-and-separation image is carried by أُبَرِّئُ at 12:53:2:1, while the accepted life-bearing self facet is carried by نَفْسِي at 12:53:3:1. The generic focus self, and the supplied self-awareness and divine-knowledge connections, provide independent triggers that keep the person joined to the act rather than separated from it.
findings.reader_payoff: The first clause can be heard as disciplined limitation: clearing a specific charge does not sever the living person from the wider capacity to be responsible.
findings.containment: The packet does not resolve the speaker boundary across 12:52-53, does not establish fatalism, and does not activate the unresolved root_000100/B002 alternative. The nominated clearance branch is a qualified source image, not an accepted independent lexicon identity.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk support is legacy-unbound, but both retained carriers are supplied in the focus surface and the contextual rows give an explicit self-accountability contact; the clearance branch remains qualified because it is nominated rather than independently registered.

branch_activations.carrier: أُبَرِّئُ carries the act of clearing or separating the speaker from fault or a deed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The speaker's own self is the object of the act, while the 8:58 and 11:54 connections supply wider rupture, accusation, witness, and disavowal contexts.
branch_activations.activation: The clearance verb meets its own-self object and the supplied public-disavowal contexts, making separation from one charge compatible with continued personal liability.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Self-exoneration is bounded to the immediate claim rather than becoming a total separation of the person from fault.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not decide who speaks across the adjacent ayat and does not import the unresolved root_000100/B002 mapping.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bedene yaşam veren ve bedenden ayrılması ölüm sayılan candır.
branch_activations.carrier: نَفْسِي carries the speaker as a living individual attached to the act of self-clearance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The definite generic self in the diagnosis, together with the 75:14 self-awareness and 53:32 divine-knowledge connections, keeps the living person in view.
branch_activations.activation: The individual self named in the opening meets the generic self that is diagnosed later; the contact turns an abstract clearance claim into a statement made by an accountable living subject.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Responsibility remains embodied in the person even as a particular accusation is being bounded.
branch_activations.boundary: This activates the life-bearing person facet; it does not claim that the focus's self is only bodily life or import every inner-thought facet.

findings.title: Vindication does not become total separation
findings.claim: The clearance-and-separation wording supports a bounded act of vindication: a specific charge may be addressed without certifying the self as wholly separate from fault.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb أُبَرِّئُ is the carrier for the nominated clearance image. Its contact with supplied rupture, accusation, witness, and public-disavowal connections gives the opening a speech-act boundary: the speaker limits what is being cleared instead of turning one vindication into a complete account of the self.
findings.reader_payoff: The opening refusal becomes more precise than a general confession or a general acquittal; it marks the difference between answering a charge and declaring the whole self innocent.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual reading from a legacy-unbound wide walk. It does not resolve the speaker boundary, decide the adjacent accusation, or claim that every meaning in the clearance family is active.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus occurrence and nominated source image are supplied, while the reader-walk source and target connection morphology are legacy-unbound; the resulting claim is retained with that qualification.

branch_activations.carrier: أُبَرِّئُ carries a claim of clearance or separation from a deed, fault, or charge.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 8:58 rupture/disclosure and 43:26 public-disavowal connections supply contexts in which separation language answers a specific accusation.
branch_activations.activation: The wider public-disavowal scenes give the focus verb a bounded speech-act frame, so clearing a particular charge remains distinct from declaring the self universally innocent.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ayah's opening limits exoneration to what is actually being answered while leaving the self morally accountable.
branch_activations.boundary: The source image is qualified, the target connection morphology is absent, and the unresolved root_000100/B002 alternative is excluded.

findings.title: The self also carries an inward corrective
findings.claim: The focus's generic self can remain vulnerable to an evil-directed command while also carrying the possibility of inward self-reproach, so the person appears as morally responsive alongside the diagnosed impulse.
findings.mechanism: The accepted inner-thought, intention, and discernment facet of the focus self is carried by 12:53:5:2. The exact connection to 75:2 supplies self-reproach as an independent contextual trigger; their contact adds an inward corrective direction without removing the focus's command-toward-evil relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The self is no longer perceptible only as a one-way source of harmful pressure; the same inward subject can also recognize and censure what it does.
findings.containment: The 75:2 connection is a qualified contextual counterpart, not a claim that the adjective self-reproaching occurs in 12:53 or that it replaces the focus's evil-directed diagnosis.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and branch facet are supplied, but the connection supplies exact target Arabic without target morphology; the counterpoint is therefore retained as a bounded exploration.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin içinde tuttuğu düşünce, niyet ya da kendine özgü bilgidir.
branch_activations.carrier: النَّفْسَ can carry the inward thought, intention, and discernment of the person diagnosed by the focus predicate.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 75:2 connection presents the self-reproaching self as an inward corrective counterpart.
branch_activations.activation: The same self-language connects the focus's harmful impulse to an inward capacity for recognition and censure, adding moral responsiveness to the reading.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The self remains a responsive inner subject alongside its pull toward evil.
branch_activations.boundary: The target's morphology is not supplied; this does not import the 75:2 adjective into the focus or claim a completed act of repentance.
